packet_limits: Proposed only: Root substantive review/adoption pending. No adopted timestamp or adopted answer claim.
Dated exact-centre physical/locality facts only; no whole-cell class, annual persistence, exact reef emergence, legal shoreline, marine jurisdiction, sovereignty or title conclusion.
Every original record, flag, source-relative value, coordinate, source association and territorial/foreign-reference hold remains unchanged, including answered water locations.
Valid masks establish source presence; literal SCL remains model evidence and can conflict with visually read built/vegetated bodies. No SCL or spectral threshold decides these records.
Indices2641,2642,2643 remain explicitly unobserved outside the actual native frame; no absent pixel is called water.

Source custody reuses completed independent 3,512,899,648-byte hash verification; this transformation reads JSON identities and hashes reviewer reports only. No repeated full product hash pass, image/raster replay, remote read, new source, qualification, repair or publication.
Annual products are credible classified source-body/location evidence; they do not reveal earlier clouded RGB pixels or constitute exact shoreline, underwater depth, wet-ground or sovereignty proof.
Tree, mangrove, cropland, grass, wetland, built and bare classes preserve their specific source meanings; no generic strict dry-land conversion is made.
All original source purpose, owner association, country/territorial flags and holds remain unchanged. No authority/native/repair/selection/deployment credit.
Positive WorldCover observations are not an absence test: zero/noData and actual missing tiles remain unanswered.
